spans.s:
(म) r. 1st cl. (क्लथति)
To kill or hurt.

r. 1st cl. (क्लदते) or (इ) क्लदि (क्लंदते)
1 To be confused, to grieve.
2 To confound;
also क्लदि (क्लंदति)
1 To call.
2 To shed tears.

r. 10th cl. (क्लापयति)
To speak, to speak barbarously.

(उ, भ, ञि, इर) क्लमु r. 4th cl. (क्लाम्यति)
To be fatigued, to be weary or exhausted.

m. (-मः)
Fatigue, weariness, exhaustion.
E.
क्लम to be weary, affix घञ्.

m. (-थः)
Fatigue, exhaustion.
E.
क्लम to be weary, Uṇādi affix अथ.

n. (-त्वं)
Exhaustion, languor, fatigue.
E.
क्लमिन्, and त्व affix; also with तल्, क्लमिता.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Weary, exhausted.
E.
क्लम, and इनि aff.

r. 1st cl. (क्लवते)
To fear, to be afraid: वि is usually prefixed in this sense.

Depressed in spirits or exhausted.
E.
क्लम to be weary, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Low spirited, languid, melancholy.
E.
क्लान्त, and मनस् the mind.

f. (-न्तिः)
Fatigue, weariness.
E.
क्लम to be weary, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-च्छित् or च्छिद्)
Relieving fatigue, refreshing, invigorating.
E.
क्लान्ति, and च्छिद् what cuts.

m. (-दः)
Refreshing, restoring, removing fatigue.
E.
क्लान्ति, and च्छेद cutting.
